messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — we need clear owners + target dates for the remediation items. I sketched a sprint-level commitment below. Who can take the CI flake root cause and its follow-through?

Jonah: I can take the CI flake investigation. Will open a ticket and try to have a repro + proposed fix by end of next week.

Maya: Thanks @Jonah — please link the ticket here when created. Aim: triage -> hotfix -> monitor in canary within 10 business days if feasible.

OpsBot: Created JIRA ticket RDX-2891: "CI: flaky integration tests causing deploy rollbacks" assigned to Jonah. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDX-2891

Samir: I'll own the rollout hardening work (retry/backoff + alert tuning). I'll pair with Jonah once the repro is up. Proposed due date 2024-07-05.

Emily: Noted the recurring pattern: this is the 3rd similar incident in 6 weeks. Suggest we add a recurring RCA slot to the oncall rotation and a dashboard showing flaky test rate by job.

Lee: Can we also add RACI annotations to each ticket so handoffs are clear? For example: R=Jonah, A=Maya, C=Samir, I=Platform Oncall. I'll paste a minimal RACI template we can copy into the Jira description: 

```
R: Owner (responsible for executing the remediation)
A: Accountable (sign-off on completion/date)
C: Consulted (advisors, reviewers)
I: Informed (oncall, stakeholders)
Due: YYYY-MM-DD
Acceptance: short test/monitoring criteria
```

Maya: Perfect. @Lee can you add that to the Jira issue and to the postmortem follow-up checklist page? Also add a field for recurrence_count.

Lee: On it — will update RDX-2891 and add a link to the Confluence follow-ups doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Remediation+Tracker

Jonah: RDX-2891 description updated with RACI and the test repro steps. ETA for repro: 2024-06-28.

Samir: I'll schedule a canary rollout window for 2024-07-06 and put an alert threshold: 5 failing jobs in 1 hour -> rollback.

Emily: For process, I propose: (1) ticket created within 24h of PM closure, (2) owner assigned w/in 48h, (3) canary plan & monitor attached before rollout. Also a monthly "recurring faults" review with SRE + Test infra.

Maya: Agreed. I'll create a recurring calendar invite for the monthly review and add the remediation tracker as a standing item.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Monthly recurring incident review" starting 2024-07-10, attendees: SRE, TestInfra, PMs.

Jonah: Quick Q — should we merge the flaky-test work with the broader test-infra backlog item (RDX-2700) or treat as standalone?

Lee: Put a link to RDX-2700 in the ticket and set RDX-2891 as a dependent short-term task. We'll avoid scope creep but ensure long-term fixes feed into 2700.

Maya: Action items recap (copy to ticket comments):
- Jonah: RDX-2891, repro + proposed fix, due 2024-06-28 (R)
- Samir: Rollout hardening + canary, due 2024-07-06 (R)
- Lee: Add RACI + Confluence update, due 2024-06-27 (A)
- Emily: Setup monthly recurring incident review invite + dashboard spec, due 2024-07-02 (C)

Samir: Acked. I'll update ticket with canary runbook and rollback thresholds.

Emily: I'll start the Grafana spec tonight and post screenshots.

Maya: Thanks all — please keep updates in RDX-2891 and ping here for blockers. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
